tools.name: search_policy_documents
tools.description: Semantic search over the Lumora HR policy library. Returns the top-k policy chunks with doc_id, title, section, a citation string such as 'POL-002 §5', the snippet text, and a score. Always use this before stating any policy fact.

query.description: Natural-language question or keywords, e.g. 'notice required for 3 days PTO'.
query.title: Query

doc_ids.description: Optional filter, e.g. ['POL-002'] to search only the PTO policy.
doc_ids.title: Doc Ids

tools.name: get_policy_section
tools.description: Return the full text of one section of a policy document (use after search to read a rule in full).

section.description: Section number such as '4' or '5.1', or words from the heading.
section.title: Section

tools.name: list_policy_documents
tools.description: List all policy documents (ID, title, source file, section headings) in the library.

tools.name: lookup_employee_profile
tools.description: Look up an employee's (synthetic) profile: title, department, employment type, FTE, hire date, tenure, work arrangement, work location, office, manager, and introductory-period status.

tools.name: check_pto_balance
tools.description: Return the employee's PTO balance (available days, pending requests, accrual tier, cap, carryover limit, floating holidays and sick days remaining). Contractors and interns do not accrue PTO.

tools.name: lookup_benefits_status
tools.description: Return the employee's current benefit elections and which benefit programs they are eligible for based on employment type and FTE (POL-001 §4, POL-008 §2).

tools.name: check_policy_compliance
tools.description: Check a concrete request against Lumora policy rules using the employee's mock data. Returns a decision (compliant / needs_approval / partially_compliant / not_compliant / not_eligible / needs_more_info), each rule checked with its policy citation, required approvals, and next steps.

employee_id.description: Employee ID the request is for.
employee_id.title: Employee Id

request_type.description: pto = time off; remote_work_domestic = temporary work from another state/province; work_from_abroad = working from another country; expense = reimbursement or stipend.
request_type.title: Request Type

start_date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD of the first day (PTO / travel).
start_date.title: Start Date

end_date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD of the last day.
end_date.title: End Date

days.description: PTO: number of business days requested.
days.title: Days

weeks.description: Work from abroad / remote: duration in weeks.
weeks.title: Weeks

calendar_days.description: Remote domestic: total calendar days away.
calendar_days.title: Calendar Days

workdays.description: Work from abroad: number of workdays abroad.
workdays.title: Workdays

destination_country.description: Work from abroad: destination country, e.g. 'Portugal'.
destination_country.title: Destination Country

destination_state.description: Remote domestic: destination state/province code, e.g. 'CO'.
destination_state.title: Destination State

tools.name: create_mock_hr_ticket
tools.description: Create a MOCK HR ticket (no real system is touched). With confirm=false it only returns a preview and asks for confirmation. Employee Relations tickets are automatically priority P1 (POL-013 §4).

employee_id.description: Employee ID the ticket is for.
employee_id.title: Employee Id

details.description: Relevant dates, policy sections reviewed, etc. No medical details.
details.title: Details

confirm.description: false = return a preview only (default). true = create the mock ticket; only allowed after the user explicitly confirms.
confirm.title: Confirm

tools.name: draft_hr_email
tools.description: Draft (never send) an email for the employee to review and send themselves.

recipient.description: Who the draft is addressed to.
recipient.title: Recipient

key_points.description: Short facts to include, e.g. dates, days, policy citations.
key_points.title: Key Points
